description: The verdict for a stored receipt file beside the latest ledger row of its request. input.ledger is the row, input.receipt the file (null: no file). imd-flop: settlement.ts reconcile(ledger, receipt). viewer: build-lane.py classify(ledger, receipt), in the same four words: its kind disagree is "disagree", settled_unknown is "settled_unknown", matches and over_limit are "agree", and every kind decided before the comparison (refused, no_receipt, key_expired, read_failed, mismatch) is "not_compared". For a compared vector the viewer adapter also asks disagrees() and settled_unknown() directly. Both parts are expected to give the same verdict; each loader checks that, except on a vector that names a quirk. imd-flop shows the DISAGREE text (run, receipt <id>, status) exactly when the verdict is "disagree".
status: booking step, review of the audit 8ddc5d2 fixes: imd-flop's verdict is new there; the viewer's is its behavior unchanged
